title: Construction contract dispute · Two parties on each side (illustrative data)

sources.name: Construction contract
sources.quote: The construction period is 180 calendar days and the quality standard is 'qualified'.

sources.name: Supervisor's monthly report
sources.quote: Localised honeycombing and pitting were found on the second-floor roof slab; a supervisor's notice was issued requiring rectification.

sources.name: Completion acceptance record
sources.quote: Rectification is complete and the re-inspection is satisfactory; the works may proceed to completion acceptance.

events.label: Owner and general contractor sign the construction contract
events.detail: The construction period was agreed at 180 calendar days, the quality standard at 'qualified', and the price was to be paid in three instalments by progress.

events.label: Owner issues the notice to commence work
events.detail: The owner notified the general contractor in writing, designating 15 April 2024 as the commencement date.

events.label: Supervisor enters the site
events.detail: The supervisor entered the site the same day and began on-site supervision of key processes, issuing a supervision log.

events.label: Subcontractor enters the site to work
events.detail: The general contractor subcontracted the waterproofing works to the subcontractor, which entered the site to work; its qualifications had been submitted and approved.

events.label: Supervisor finds a quality problem on inspection
events.detail: On inspection the supervisor found localised honeycombing and pitting on the second-floor roof slab, and issued a supervisor's notice requiring rectification.

events.label: General contractor suspends work on that part
events.detail: The general contractor suspended work on the second-floor roof slab, pending resumption once the rectification plan was settled.

events.label: The three parties agree a rectification plan
events.summary: Subcontractor to cut out and redo
events.detail: The owner, the general contractor and the subcontractor jointly confirmed a rectification plan: the subcontractor was to cut out and redo the work, which would be accepted to the original standard.

events.label: Subcontractor completes rectification
events.summary: Cut out and redone, re-inspection sought
events.detail: The subcontractor completed the cut-out and redo, and requested re-inspection by the supervisor.

events.label: Supervisor's re-inspection is satisfactory
events.detail: The supervisor's re-inspection was satisfactory and it issued a written opinion allowing the works to proceed to completion acceptance.

events.label: General contractor applies for completion acceptance
events.detail: The general contractor submitted an application for completion acceptance; the works passed acceptance on 30 September 2024, but the construction price was not paid on time.
